macro.event: Bank of England Bank Rate decision + minutes — LANDED
macro.consensus: was a hold at 3.75%, and that was DELIVERED — but only 6-3, with Greene, Mann and Pill all dissenting FOR +25bp and the MPC judging inflation risks tilted to the upside. Separately and unanimously, the MPC voted to take the gilt stock to ZERO at only GBP 20bn/yr of active sales (~GBP 46bn/yr with maturities, complete end-2034) — well below the ~GBP 50bn pace the market had assumed
macro.note: hawkish on rates, dovish on gilt supply — which is why cable held 1.3400
